title: xfleet state-file schema
description: Canonical SHAPE contract for the two xfleet state files under $XFLEET_COORDINATION_ROOT/state/. The $def 'orchestrator' validates _orchestrator.json (orchestrator-only writes); the $def 'worker' validates {worker}.json (worker-only writes). Prose (lifecycle, cross-field invariants, writer ownership) lives in shared/state-schema.md; its Field Reference table is generated from this file. Every property carries a description: the doc generator and the Task-17b drift detector both depend on it.

orchestrator.title: _orchestrator.json
orchestrator.description: Orchestrator-private runtime state, written only by the orchestrator session and read only by it. Lives at $XFLEET_COORDINATION_ROOT/state/_orchestrator.json. Survives /compact on disk; created lazily on first use.

schema_version.description: State-file schema version (SC-6). Always the string "1" for this revision. The Task-18 validator and Task-19 migration helper key off this field; a missing or mismatched value is rejected.

cycles.description: Count of approval-gate re-open cycles in this session. Incremented each time the human requests changes at a phase approval gate; drives convergence warnings.

last_all_idle_notify.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent "all workers idle" Slack prompt, or null if never sent. Rate-limits re-sends of the all-idle nudge.

last_round5_pause.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent round-5 hard-stop force-escalation pause, or null if never triggered. Rate-limits the round-5 disagreement flow.

phase_emissions.description: Map of phase name -> signal name -> emission record, tracking which gated phase signals the orchestrator has emitted (and whether human-approved). Arbitrary phase and signal names are allowed as map keys; the value object is strict.

additionalProperties.description: Map of signal name -> emission record for one phase.
A single gated-emission record for one (phase, signal) pair.

approved_by_human.description: Whether a human approved this emission at the phase gate (F-17).

sent_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the signal was emitted.

sent_to.description: Worker short-names the signal was sent to.

emission_id.description: Unique id for this emission; correlates with the emission_log entry.

emission_log.description: Append-only log of every gated-emission attempt (successful or not), for audit.

phase.description: Phase the emission was attempted for.

approved_by_human.description: Whether the attempt was human-approved at the gate.

emission_id.description: Unique id correlating with the phase_emissions record.

outcome.description: Result of the attempt (e.g. sent, blocked, deferred).

human_engaged.description: Whether a human is actively engaged in the session. Cross-field invariant (sync-mechanism ADR): active=true iff `xfleet engage` was called OR a directive was dispatched; cleared by `xfleet disengage`.

active.description: True when a human is engaged. Auto-set true on directive dispatch (cluster 4a); never auto-fired by escalation arrival.

concern_id.description: Concern id the human engagement is scoped to, or null if not concern-scoped.

set_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the engagement was set, or null when inactive.

reason.description: Human-readable reason engagement was set, or null when inactive.

completion_log.description: Append-only log of phase-completion evaluations, recording which workers/signals were still missing at each check.

trigger_msg_type.description: Inbound message type that triggered the evaluation (e.g. phase-complete).

worker.description: Short-name of the worker whose phase-complete triggered this evaluation.

phase.description: Phase the evaluation was computed for (from the triggering phase-complete message).

outcome.description: Result of the evaluation (e.g. complete, incomplete).

missing_workers.description: Worker short-names that had not yet reported for the phase.

missing_signals.description: Signal names still outstanding for the phase.

directive_log.description: Append-only log of directives the orchestrator dispatched to workers.

target.description: Worker short-name the directive was dispatched to.

concern_id.description: Concern id the directive addresses, or null if not concern-driven.

expected_action.description: Action the orchestrator expects the worker to take.

dispatched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the directive was dispatched.

response_status.description: Current status of the worker's response (e.g. pending, acked, done).

task_log.description: Append-only log of tasks the orchestrator dispatched to workers.

target.description: Worker short-name the task was dispatched to.

dispatched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the task was dispatched.

response_status.description: Current status of the worker's response (e.g. pending, done).

escalation_log.description: Append-only log of escalations received from workers and their surfacing/resolution lifecycle.

source_worker.description: Worker short-name that raised the escalation.

path.description: Path to the escalation message body under $XFLEET_COORDINATION_ROOT.

priority.description: Routing class derived from reason; one of `urgent` or `non-urgent` per messaging.md section (c).

received_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the escalation was received.

surfaced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the escalation was surfaced to the human.

resolved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the escalation was resolved, or null if still open.

integration_readiness.description: Per-IP per-repo readiness flags; outer key IP-{N}, inner key repo name. Set by integration-ready-handler; reset on IP amendment/reopen.

ip_status.description: Per-IP lifecycle state. status set by orchestrator IP-verification flow; verified_at on T4 close; version bumped on amendment.

verified_at.description: ISO timestamp when IP reached verified, else null.

drift_log.description: Append-only log of drift detections per IP close; classification per API Evolve taxonomy.

resolved_at.description: ISO timestamp when the drift was resolved, else null.

worker.title: {worker}.json
worker.description: Per-worker live state, written only by the owning worker session and read by the orchestrator via `xfleet status`. Lives at $XFLEET_COORDINATION_ROOT/state/{worker}.json. Note: prepare_compact_at is NOT a stored field — it is derived from the filesystem mtime of the most recent handoff-{phase}.md.

schema_version.description: State-file schema version (SC-6). Always the string "1" for this revision. The Task-18 validator and Task-19 migration helper key off this field; a missing or mismatched value is rejected.

current_phase.description: The phase skill the worker currently has loaded (e.g. idle, qa-spec, repo-spec, plan, implement, cross-review, alignment).

status.description: Authoritative busy/free signal, orthogonal to current_phase. working = mid-task; idle = reachable, no active task; blocked = waiting on an external decision; compacting = context near auto-compact threshold, handoff written, awaiting human /clear + resume.

current_task.description: The in-flight unit of work, or null when the worker has no active task.

task_id.description: Unique id for the in-flight task.

source.description: Origin of the task: self (worker-initiated), orch-task (xfleet task), or orch-directive (xfleet directive).

received_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the task was received/started.

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent write to this file. The orchestrator's straggler detection reads this field.

listen_bash_id.description: Id of the background bash process running the worker's inbox listener.

standby.description: True when the worker is on standby (paused phase-specific handling while always-on handlers stay active).

context_pct.description: Most recent context-window usage reading, 0-100. Drives warn/compact transitions.

review_revision_count.description: Number of review/revision rounds completed in the current phase. Resets to 0 on phase entry.

findings_status.description: Map of finding id -> lifecycle status for findings the worker is tracking. Arbitrary finding ids are allowed as map keys; each value must be one of the enumerated statuses.

confirmed_closed_concerns.description: Concern ids this worker has confirmed closed via the resolution closure handshake.

last_warn_emitted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the last context warn was emitted, or null. Debounces warn emissions (cluster 4j); resets on phase entry; cleared when context_pct drops below the warn threshold.

last_check_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last context check, or null. Throttles below-warn context checks (cluster 4j).

current_ip.description: IP this worker is currently working toward; null when between IPs.

ip_self_check.description: Per-IP per-contract self-check status from verification-before-completion at epic close. Written by xfleet drift-check.
